items.h: Held in check Sunday
items.s: Goodson took seven carries for 14 yards and caught both of his two targets for 19 yards during Sunday's 33-30 overtime loss versus the Cardinals. Dallas wasn't really able to get anything going on the ground in Week 8, totaling just 93 rushing yards on 39 carries. Just like the offense as a whole, Goodson found a bit more success in the passing game, and he posted his best receiving total since back in 2024. As long as starter Javonte Williams remains available, though, Goodson should stay in a change-of-pace role.

items.h: Tyler Goodson quiet in Week 8
items.s: Tyler Goodson rushed seven times for 14 yards while also catching both of his targets for 19 yards in the Cowboys' 33-30 loss to the Cardinals in Week 8. Goodson remains minimally involved out of the backfield, rushing for less than 40 yards in each of his six contests. The running back can remain off rosters in all formats ahead of a Week 9 contest against the Indianapolis Colts.

items.h: Tyler Goodson Has Locked Down Dallas' Backup Running Back Job
items.s: Dallas Cowboys running back Tyler Goodson has solidified his position as the primary backup to Javonte Williams, with Malik Davis (hip) remaining on injured reserve. Goodson handled a season-high 10 carries for 38 yards in Monday's 38-21 victory over the Philadelphia Eagles, while Williams dominated with 25 attempts for a career-high 155 yards and a touchdown. Despite the increased carries, Goodson played just 14 offensive snaps (21%) and wasn't targeted, leaving him with minimal standalone fantasy value, and he has accumulated 72 rushing yards on 21 carries this season. His depth-chart position remains secure, and he would be first in line for additional rushing opportunities if Williams…

items.h: Logs 10 carries during Monday's win
items.s: Goodson turned 10 carries into 38 yards and returned two kickoffs for 42 yards during the Cowboys' 38-21 win over the Eagles on Monday. The Cowboys relied heavily on the run game Monday, and Goodson saw a season-high 10 rushes as a result, although that was still well behind the workload of lead back Javonte Williams, who turned 25 carries into a career-high 155 yards and a score. Goodson nearly found the end zone himself after returning a 91-yard kickoff to the house in the second quarter, only for the touchdown to be nullified by a holding penalty on Dallas. He's limited to RB2 duties for the time being but would step into an elevated role if Williams were to ever miss time. The Cowboys…

items.h: Tyler Goodson inefficient in win Monday
items.s: Tyler Goodson rushed the ball ten times for 38 yards in Monday night's 38-21 win over the Philadelphia Eagles. Goodson was given ten carries on Monday night, but he wasn't able to do a whole lot with them, contributing 38 yards in the team's win over Philadelphia. He won't be fantasy relevant for as long as Javonte Williams remains healthy and on the field for Dallas moving forward.

items.h: Tyler Goodson the Top RB Handcuff in Dallas
items.s: Although Dallas Cowboys running back Tyler Goodson has barely seen the field this year, he is the clear RB2 in Dallas as the handcuff for fantasy managers who have starter Javonte Williams rostered. Goodson, an undrafted free agent from Iowa, has appeared in four games for the Cowboys so far this year and has 11 rushing attempts for 34 yards while catching two of five targets for four yards. In his first three seasons with the Indianapolis Colts, the 25-year-old had 54 carries for 264 yards and one touchdown on the ground while adding 19 catches on 27 targets for 103 yards and one touchdown through the air in 33 games played (one start). Goodson began the year on the Atlanta Falcons'…

items.h: Tyler Goodson catches one pass in Week 6
items.s: Tyler Goodson gained zero yards on two carries while catching his lone target for a nine-yard gain in a 23-13 loss to the Packers in Week 6. Goodson was quiet while mixing in behind starter Javonte Williams in the loss. The veteran running back should continue to be treated as nothing more than a handcuff in fantasy moving forward.

items.h: Tyler Goodson a Potential Waiver-Wire Addition as Handcuff
items.s: Cowboys running back Tyler Goodson is a handcuff option and a potential deep-league waiver wire addition as Dallas prepares to face the Green Bay Packers in Week 6. Goodson didn't receive a carry or a target during the Cowboys' loss at the hands of the Tampa Bay Buccaneers last week, but remains the backup to starter Javonte Williams, RotoBaller's eighth-ranked running back. The Packers have allowed 127.6 yards per game this season, ninth-worst in the NFL. With that said, the Green Bay defense limited the Chicago Bears to just 81 yards on the ground during a Week 5 win last Sunday.

items.h: Tyler Goodson (ankle) off injury report Thursday
items.s: Tyler Goodson is off the injury report for Thursday's game against the Buccaneers. Goodson will remain in his change-of-pace role behind Javonte Williams.

items.h: Tyler Goodson (ankle) practices in full Tuesday
items.s: Tyler Goodson was a full participant in practice on Tuesday. Goodson should remain in his reserve role in the Cowboys backfield behind Javonte Williams.

items.h: Tyler Goodson A Deep-League Waiver Option As Handcuff
items.s: Dallas Cowboys running back Tyler Goodson hasn't been very involved in his team's offense this season, even though he's the clear RB2 behind starter Javonte Williams. Cowboys RB Malik Davis (hip) was set for that role, but was placed on season-ending injured reserve, clearing the path for Goodson to be second on the depth chart. Williams rushed for three touchdowns and caught five passes in Week 4 in a narrow win over the Houston Texans. Goodson saw just three rushes and one target in the contest. Williams is the workhorse back for the team, but if he were to get injured, Goodson would be in line for a big role that would vault him into starting conversation. The Cowboys run game has been…

items.h: Goodson is active for Sunday's game against the Ravens.
items.s: Todd Archer of ESPN.com initially reported that Goodson would be a healthy scratch. Instead, it will be Emari Demercado (coach's decision) that will be inactive, with Goodson and Javonte Williams the active running backs for the Cowboys in Brazil.

items.h: Goodson (coach's decision) is inactive for Sunday's game against the Ravens, Todd Archer of ESPN.com reports.
items.s: Goodson will be a healthy scratch for a second consecutive week, with the Cowboys going with two running backs on the game day roster in Javonte Williams and Emari Demercado. Goodson's next chance to play is Week 4 against the Texans on Sunday, Oct. 4.

items.h: Goodson (coach's decision) is inactive for Sunday's game against the Commanders, Todd Archer of ESPN.com reports.
items.s: Goodson will be a healthy scratch for Week 2. The No. 3 running back was signed to the Cowboys' active roster Sept. 15. Goodson will not suit up for his first game as a Cowboy, though it is unclear whether it is because he is not needed or not prepared yet.

items.h: Goodson was signed to the Cowboys' active roster Tuesday.
items.s: Goodson signed with the Falcons' practice squad Aug. 31, but he will now head to Dallas ahead of Week 2. The running back will provide the team with an additional depth option behind starter Javonte Williams and primary backup Emari Demercado against the Commanders on Sunday. In a corresponding move, fellow running back Israel Abanikanda was waived Tuesday.

items.h: Goodson signed with the Falcons' practice squad Monday, Will McFadden of the team's official site reports.
items.s: The running back was let go by the team Sunday. Goodson carried the ball nine times for 24 yards last season for Indianapolis, and he also played on 127 special-teams snaps.

items.h: Goodson signed a contract with the Falcons on Thursday, Will McFadden of the team's official site reports.
items.s: Goodson will likely compete for a depth role in training camp behind Bijan Robinson and Brian Robinson. Atlanta also has Nathan Carter and Carlos Washington under contract at running back. Goodson recorded 54 carries for 264 yards and one touchdown across 33 regular-season appearances for the Colts over the past three seasons while adding 19 catches for 103 yards and a touchdown on 27 targets.

items.h: The Colts did not tender Goodson as a restricted free agent Wednesday.
items.s: Goodson now is a free agent after rushing just nine times for 24 scoreless yards across 11 regular-season appearances during the 2025 campaign. The 25-year-old has a career 54-264-1 rushing line and 19 catches for 103 yards and one touchdown on 27 targets.

items.h: Goodson rushed once for three yards in Sunday's 38-30 loss to the Texans. He finished the season with nine rushes for 24 yards, adding two receptions for eight yards on three targets in 11 appearances.
items.s: Goodson was a nonfactor this season, barely seeing the field on offense. The 25-year-old running back played well behind Jonathan Taylor and Ameer Abdullah in the Colts' backfield rotation throughout the 2025 campaign. With that said, Goodson will enter the offseason as a restricted free agent, giving Indianapolis the opportunity to match any offers he may receive from other teams in free agency. Based on his limited usage, it remains unclear if the Colts will try to keep him in their locker room or afford him the opportunity to catch on with another team ahead of next season.

items.h: Goodson (ankle) wasn't listed on the Colts' first Week 18 injury report Wednesday.
items.s: Goodson sat out a Week 17 loss to the Jaguars due to an ankle injury, but the issue clearly is behind him, and he'll be available Sunday at Houston for his typical roles on special teams and whatever top two RBs Jonathan Taylor and Ameer Abdullah may cede on offense. In 10 games this season, Goodson has eight carries for 21 yards, two catches (on three targets) for eight yards, no touchdowns and two kick returns for 60 yards.

items.h: Goodson (ankle) is inactive for Sunday's game against the Jaguars.
items.s: Despite closing Week 17 prep with a full practice, Goodson will get some extra time to recover from the ankle injury that kept him from practicing in any fashion Wednesday and Thursday. With Goodson sidelined, the Colts will keep rookie DJ Giddens active as their No. 3 running back behind Jonathan Taylor and Ameer Abdullah.

items.h: Goodson (ankle) is questionable ahead of Sunday's game against the Jaguars, James Boyd of The Athletic reports.
items.s: Goodson likely sustained his ankle injury against the 49ers during last Monday's loss, but the running back was able to upgrade to full participation in Friday's practice. The upgrade from non-participation to full is a great sign that the 25-year-old has recovered enough to suit up for Sunday's game. If Goodson is unable to play, DJ Giddens will likely share a few offensive snaps with Ameer Abdullah behind lead back Jonathan Taylor.

items.h: Goodson (ankle) was listed as a DNP on Wednesday's estimated practice report.
items.s: Goodson likely tweaked his ankle during the Colts' loss to the 49ers on Monday, when he turned three carries into nine yards and added 60 yards on two kickoff returns. He'll have two more opportunities to return to practice ahead of Sunday's AFC South tilt against Jacksonville.

items.h: Goodson rushed three times for nine yards in Monday's 48-27 loss to the 49ers.
items.s: Goodson's three carries Monday were his first rushing attempts since Week 10. In 10 appearances, the 25-year-old running back has recorded just eight rushes for 21 yards, adding two catches on three targets for eight yards. Barring an injury to Jonathan Taylor down the stretch, Goodson will remain far off the fantasy radar in a Week 17 matchup against the Jaguars.

items.h: Goodson failed to record a single offensive snap in Sunday's 18-16 loss to the Seahawks.
items.s: Goodson was not involved on offense Sunday, as the third-year running back failed to record an offensive snap for the second time this season. The 25-year-old has not been a big part of the game plan all season, playing just 28 offensive snaps in nine appearances during the 2025 campaign. Goodson has recorded just five rushes for 12 yards and two catches for eight yards over the course of the season. The Iowa product remains far off the fantasy radar heading into a Week 16 matchup against the 49ers.

items.h: Goodson failed to record a single carry or target in Sunday's 36-19 loss to the Jaguars.
items.s: Goodson was a complete nonfactor Sunday, as the running back played just one of the Colts' 70 offensive snaps behind Jonathan Taylor (52) and Ameer Abdullah (17). For fantasy purposes, the 25-year-old Goodson remains an interesting insurance policy if Taylor misses time due to injury, but the Iowa product should otherwise remain far off the fantasy radar when the Colts visit the Seahawks in Week 15.

items.h: Goodson failed to record a single carry or target in Sunday's 23-20 loss to the Chiefs.
items.s: Goodson played just one of the Colts' 51 offensive snaps Sunday while starter Jonathan Taylor dominated the running back snap share with 46 snaps. The 25-year-old Goodson has barely been used on offense this season, playing just 27 snaps and recording five rushes and two receptions for 20 total yards across six appearances. The Iowa product remains far off the fantasy radar heading into a Week 13 matchup against the Texans.

items.h: Goodson rushed once for four yards in Sunday's 31-25 win over the Falcons.
items.s: Goodson played just two of the Colts' 77 offensive snaps Sunday, behind both Jonathan Taylor (70) and Ameer Abdullah (5). With Taylor handling a 91 percent snap share and rushing for 244 yards and three touchdowns, the 25-year-old Goodson was not relied upon in the Colts' offensive plans. This has been the case for most of the 2025 campaign, as the third-year running back has recorded just five carries for 12 yards and two catches for eight yards in the five games he's played so far. Barring an injury to Taylor, Goodson is far off the fantasy radar as Indianapolis heads into its Week 11 bye…

items.h: Goodson had one reception for eight yards on two targets in Sunday's loss at Pittsburgh.
items.s: Goodson played a season-high 10 snaps on offense with the Colts trailing most of the game. However, the Colts didn't turn to a pass-catching running back as they have in the past as Jonathan Taylor stayed in the game and played on 62 of the offense's 79 snaps. Ameer Abdullah played on five snaps and had one carry and one reception. As long as Taylor is healthy, it looks the other running backs will have very minor roles even if the Colts are forced throw the ball.

items.h: Goodson had two carries for two yards in Sunday's 38-14 win over Tennessee.
items.s: Goodson returned after missing three games due to a groin injury. He's clearly ahead of DJ Giddens on the depth chart, as the rookie was a healthy inactive. However, Ameer Abdullah may be the No. 2 running back even with Goodson healthy as he played 10 offensive snaps compared to four for Goodson. Both had only two carries however, and none of the backups will get enough touches to have viable fantasy value as long as Jonathan Taylor dominates the workload even in blowouts, as Sunday's win was essentially wrapped up before the fourth quarter.

items.h: Goodson (groin) was a full participant in Wednesday's practice.
items.s: Goodson didn't suit up for Indianapolis' win over the Chargers in Week 7, his third consecutive absence, but he now appears back to full health. He'll be available to contribute in a reserve capacity behind workhorse running back Jonathan Taylor versus the Titans on Sunday.

items.h: Goodson (groin) has been ruled out ahead of Sunday's game against the Chargers.
items.s: Goodson practiced in limited fashion Friday, but that won't be enough for him to take the field in Week 7. This will mark his third consecutive absence and leave DJ Giddens as the backup to Jonathan Taylor.

items.h: Goodson (groin) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Chargers.
items.s: Goodson managed to practice in limited fashion Friday after being sidelined Wednesday and Thursday. Even if he returns from a two-week absence Sunday, Goodson wouldn't be expected to contribute much as one of the backups to Jonathan Taylor, along with DJ Giddens and possibly practice squad running back Ameer Abdullah.

items.h: Goodson (groin) remained a non-participant in practice Thursday, James Boyd of The Athletic reports.
items.s: Goodson seems to be trending toward a third consecutive absence Sunday against the Chargers. Ameer Abdullah handled the only two touches that didn't go to Jonathan Taylor among Colts running backs in their Week 6 win over the Cardinals, and rookie DJ Giddens remains on hand in a depth role.

items.h: Goodson (groin) did not participate in Wednesday's practice.
items.s: Goodson has missed the Colts' last two games due to a groin injury that he picked up in Week 4 against the Rams. He'll need to return to practice in at least a limited capacity in order to have a realistic chance of playing against the Chargers on Sunday. DJ Giddens and practice squad member Ameer Abdullah will continue to handle backup duties out of the backfield behind Jonathan Taylor for as long as Goodson is out of action.

items.h: Goodson (groin) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Cardinals, Amanda Foster of the Colts' official site reports.
items.s: Goodson will miss a second consecutive game due to the groin injury he sustained in Week 4 against the Rams. DJ Giddens will continue to work as the primary backup to workhorse running back Jonathan Taylor.

items.h: Goodson (groin) didn't participate in Wednesday's practice, James Boyd of The Athletic reports.
items.s: Goodson sustained a groin injury in the Colts' Week 4 win loss to the Rams and hasn't returned to practice since. The Iowa product has played just 24 snaps (16 on special teams, eight on offense) across two appearances this season, rushing twice for six yards. He likely needs to upgrade to at least limited practice Thursday or Friday to have a chance at suiting up for the Week 6 matchup against the Cardinals.

items.h: Goodson (groin) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Raiders, Amanda Foster of the Colts' official site reports.
items.s: Goodson, who sustained his groin injury during Week 4 action, didn't practice this week and now will target a potential return Sunday, Oct. 12 against the Cardinals. In Goodson's absence this weekend, DJ Giddens will back up Jonathan Taylor, with Ameer Abdullah and Ulysses Bentley representing possible practice-squad elevations.

items.h: Goodson (groin) remained sidelined at Thursday's practice, James Boyd of The Athletic reports.
items.s: Goodson suffered the injury last Sunday against the Rams. If he's unable to go against the Raiders in Week 5, Jonathan Taylor and DJ Giddens will handle backfield duties for the Colts.

items.h: Goodson (groin) did not practice Wednesday.
items.s: Goodson missed the first two games of the season with an elbow injury but injured his groin in Week 4 against the Rams. Goodson has played a total of eight offensive snaps across two appearances, rushing twice for six yards while catching one pass for no gain.

items.h: Goodson (groin) has been ruled out for the rest of Sunday's game against the Rams.
items.s: Jonathan Taylor and DJ Giddens will be the Colts' two backfield options for the rest of Sunday's game, although Goodson's involvement in the offense has been minimal so far in 2025.

items.h: Goodson is questionable to return to Sunday's game against the Rams due to a groin injury, James Boyd of The Athletic reports.
items.s: Goodson will continue to be evaluated by medical staff to determine whether he can return to Sunday's contest. DJ Giddens will be the lone backup running back behind Jonathan Taylor if Goodson is not cleared to return.

items.h: Goodson had two carries for six yards in Sunday's win at Tennessee.
items.s: Goodson made his regular-season debut after missing the first two games due to an elbow injury. He played four snaps on offense compared to eight snaps for DJ Giddens but got one more carry. It's not clear who is Taylor's primary backup as Goodson could be used in more passing situations, but neither backup is getting much usage as Taylor again got almost all the opportunities (17 carries and four targets) and played on 77 percent of the offense's snaps.

items.h: Goodson is active for Sunday's game at Tennessee.
items.s: Goodson missed each of the Colts' first two games of the season with an elbow injury. It's not clear how much he'll play against the Titans, as Jonathan Taylor got every carry (25) among Colts running backs last week and played 93 percent of the snaps on offense. Still, Goodson could be worked in on a few passing downs when Taylor needs a rest.

items.h: Goodson (elbow) was a full participant in Wednesday's practice.
items.s: Goodson has missed each of the Colts' first two games of the season but appears to be closing in on a return. It remains to be seen if Goodson will cut into Jonathan Taylor's playing time on passing downs.

items.h: Goodson (elbow) is inactive for Sunday's Week 2 game against the Broncos.
items.s: The reserve running back will sit out for the second time in as many games to open the season due to his elbow issue, despite managing to work back to a full practice Friday. In Goodson's ongoing absence, rookie fifth-round pick DJ Giddens, who recorded 12 carries for 41 yards in the Week 1 win over the Dolphins, once again will operate as the No. 2 back behind Jonathan Taylor. Meanwhile, Goodson will turn his attention to garnering active status for the first time this season in next Sunday's road matchup against the Titans.

items.h: Goodson (elbow) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Broncos after logging a full practice Friday.
items.s: Friday's full participation level suggests Goodson's trending in the right direction, but it remains to be seen if he'll be cleared to make his season debut Sunday. Once he's healthy enough to play, Goodson will compete with rookie fifth-round pick DJ Giddens for change-of-pace work behind Jonathan Taylor.

items.h: Goodson (elbow) was limited in practice Thursday.
items.s: Goodson has been limited in practice since the start of the regular season, though he didn't gain clearance to suit up Week 1. Once ready to play, Goodson will join DJ Giddens as a depth backfield option behind starter Jonathan Taylor. His next chance to suit up will be Sunday versus the Broncos.

items.h: Goodson (elbow) was limited in practice Wednesday.
items.s: Goodson was also limited in practice prior to being officially inactive Week 1, so he may need to upgrade to full participation Thursday or Friday in order to gain clearance for Sunday's home game against the Broncos. Once healthy, Goodson will compete with DJ Giddens for reserve touches behind workhorse starter Jonathan Taylor.

items.h: Goodson (elbow) is inactive for Sunday's season opener against the Dolphins.
items.s: After being limited at practice this week, Goodson approached the contest listed as questionable. With his regular-season debut on hold, DJ Giddens and Ulysses Bentley are available Sunday to handle backfield snaps that don't go to Jonathan Taylor. Goodson's next chance to see action will occur next weekend against the Broncos.

items.h: Goodson (elbow) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Dolphins, Amanda Foster of the Colts' official site reports.
items.s: Goodson has been practicing on a limited basis. If he ultimately can't play Sunday, the Colts could elevate Khalil Herbert or Ulysses Bentley from the practice squad to join starter Jonathan Taylor and rookie fifth-round pick DJ Giddens in the backfield.

items.h: Goodson (elbow) was listed as a limited practice participant Wednesday.
items.s: As Week 1 approaches, Goodson is the only player listed on the Colts' initial injury report ahead of Sunday's game against the Dolphins. While his status for the contest shouldn't impact fantasy lineups this weekend, given that top back Jonathan Taylor is healthy, the question of whether Indy would turn to Goodson or DJ Giddens in the event of an injury to Taylor remains unsettled for now.

items.h: Colts head coach Shane Steichen said Monday that Goodson (elbow) could be among players who retake the practice field next week, Joel A. Erickson of The Indianapolis Star reports.
items.s: Goodson previously said the elbow injury he picked up during Indianapolis' preseason game against Green Bay on Aug. 16 isn't serious, and that he could be available early in the regular season. If he's indeed able to return to practice next week, Goodson could have a shot at being cleared in time for Week 1 against the Dolphins. He's competing with DJ Giddens and Khalil Herbert (undisclosed) for a depth gig behind Jonathan Taylor.

items.h: Goodson (elbow) didn't practice Thursday, James Boyd of The Athletic reports.
items.s: The elbow injury that Goodson suffered during Saturday's preseason game against the Packers isn't viewed as major, per Joel A. Erickson of The Indianapolis Star, but the running back's absence from practice Thursday suggests that he'll miss Saturday's preseason finale against the Bengals. When he's available, Goodson is competing with DJ Giddens and Khalil Herbert (undisclosed) for slotting behind top back Jonathan Taylor.

items.h: Goodson (elbow) doesn't have a major injury, Joel A. Erickson of The Indianapolis Star reports.
items.s: Goodson was the third back through the rotation in Saturday's preseason game against Green Bay, taking the field after Jonathan Taylor and fifth-round rookie DJ Giddens, but then left early with an elbow injury. It apparently isn't serious, giving Goodson a shot to be ready for Week 1 and keep a spot on the roster. Khalil Herbert (undisclosed) has also been out recently, leaving the Colts with nothing but undrafted rookies in the backfield behind Taylor and Giddens. Taylor should get the vast majority of snaps come Week 1, with Giddens and Goodson subbing in occasionally.

items.h: Goodson was forced out of Saturday's preseason game against the Packers with an elbow injury, James Boyd of The Athletic reports.
items.s: Prior to his exit from the contest, Goodson -- who was sporting a brace on his arm as he went to the locker room, per Joel A. Erickson of The Indianapolis Star -- carried twice for 10 yards with a TD. If he's forced to miss time beyond Saturday, added opportunities behind starter Jonathan Taylor would be available for rookie DJ Giddens as well as Khalil Herbert (undisclosed).

items.h: Goodson started Thursday's preseason opener at Baltimore and took four carries for 11 yards.
items.s: Goodson got the start, but rookie fifth-round pick DJ Giddens played more snaps in the first half, finishing with six carries for 17 yards (and one incomplete target). Khalil Herbert then took over in the third quarter and scored a TD, but only after entering halftime without a touch. The trio will continue competing for backup roles behind Jonathan Taylor, who was held out Thursday night along with most of the other starters.

items.h: Goodson is listed as the No. 2 running back on the Colts' first unofficial depth chart of the preseason.
items.s: Goodson is listed ahead of both DJ Giddens and Khalil Herbert. He could be given deference as a returning veteran or may be listed as the second back because he could have a role on passing downs if Jonathan Taylor is healthy. However, Giddens is seen having a stronger camp so far and would likely get the most work if Taylor were to get hurt.

items.h: Indianapolis signed Goodson to a one-year contract extension Tuesday.
items.s: In 16 appearances with the Colts in 2024, Goodson handled 32 carries for 153 yards and a touchdown and hauled in 11 of 15 targets for 61 yards and a touchdown. His role in 2025 could depend on whether Trey Sermon opts to leave in free agency during the offseason.
